fato_historico: 1111: Highest Galician nobility led by Pedro Fróilaz de Traba and the bishop Diego Gelmírez crown Alfonso VII as "King of Galicia".
energia_do_dia: Today may feel like a coronation of your spirit. Much like the ancient leaders who gathered in strength, you might find the energy perfect for reclaiming your personal authority. Consider this a time to crown your own intentions with clarity. Perhaps stepping into your truth will allow you to command your path with newfound grace and unwavering magnetic confidence.
frase_do_dia: Wear your intuition like a crown and lead your life with heart.
significado_numero: A lucky number representing spiritual wisdom and inner perfection.
conselho: Trust your gut feelings and rule your day with kindness and firm resolve.
